note: Line-by-line repository review (task T42, session arena/d26f42db-zone2). Every number in this file was measured in the working tree on 2026-11-15 by this session; none is quoted from another session's prose. Rows in `verification` record a check this session ran against an official page, with what it observed. Rows in `namespaces` and `measurements` are observations about the repository and carry no source link because they are measurements, not claims about a program rule. IMPORTANT: the tree grew while this review was running — three namespaces (audit/, release/, paths.html) were added and the root landing page was redesigned by session f8e18ca8, all merged to main on 2026-11-15. Every measurement below was therefore re-taken against the rebased tree after that merge, and MS-10 records the discrepancy.
method: Read-only review. No file outside this session's declared scope was edited. Measurements were taken with a script over the working tree at commit ceaf9a79 and the merges that followed it; official-source checks were live fetches performed on 2026-11-15 UTC.

verification.claim: An unknown code on the short-link service is refused, not redirected to a random product
verification.observed: https://link.amazon/B00TEST12 returned HTTP 404, title “404: File Not Found”, body “Uh oh, it looks like something went wrong. You’ve clicked on an invalid URL.”

verification.claim: A valid 10-character ASIN is refused by the same service, so the service does not accept ASINs
verification.observed: https://link.amazon/B0CDY277D3 returned the identical 404 page as the unknown code

verification.claim: The short-link service finally serves from a host other than link.amazon
verification.observed: Both control fetches were served from https://amzlinks.in/ — the fetcher reported the resolved URLs as amzlinks.in/B00TEST12 and amzlinks.in/B0CDY277D3

verification.claim: Operating Agreement §5 disclosure sentence, verbatim
verification.observed: “You must clearly and prominently state the following … ‘As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.’”; page header “Updated: October 15, 2025”

verification.claim: Operating Agreement §4 forbids implying expected traffic or commission income
verification.observed: “We do not make any representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the amount of traffic or commission income you can expect …”

verification.claim: Special Links must use the assigned, tagged format
verification.observed: §1: “The links must properly use the special ‘tagged’ link formats we provide …”; §6: “any violation of Section 5 … will be deemed a material breach”; termination notice 7 calendar days

verification.claim: Prices may be shown only if Amazon serves them or they come from Creators API or PA API
verification.observed: §2(b): “your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API …”

verification.claim: Star ratings and customer reviews require Creators API or PA API
verification.observed: §6(t): “You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API …”

verification.claim: Price tracking and price alerting are prohibited by default
verification.observed: §6(y): “Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.”

verification.claim: Program Content may not be used to develop machine-learning models without express prior written approval
verification.observed: §5: “You will not, without our express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.”

verification.claim: Every link must carry the Associates ID as a URL parameter
verification.observed: §2(b): “you must include your Associates ID or ‘tag’ (appearing as XXXXX-## …) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.”

verification.claim: Table 1 commission bands, including the Kitchen band
verification.observed: Eleven bands read on 2026-11-15; “Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive | 4.50%”; “All Other Categories | 4.00%”

verification.claim: Application review thresholds and content standard
verification.observed: “at least three within the first 180 days”, “personal orders do not qualify”, “at least 10 posts”, “generally within the last 60 days”, “You must own your website”, “adds value to the customer by giving them insight on a subject or product they might not get easily”

verification.claim: Creators API prerequisites
verification.observed: “Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API”; prerequisite 1 is enrolment in the Associates program

verification.claim: Amazon's published ASIN definition
verification.observed: “ASIN is the 10-digit code that Amazon uses to denote specific products.”, with published link format http://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID

verification.claim: Google's scaled content abuse policy names AI generation explicitly
verification.observed: “Scaled content abuse is when many pages are generated for the primary purpose of manipulating search rankings and not helping users …” with the first listed example “Using generative AI tools or other similar tools to generate many pages without adding value for users”

verification.claim: Google's thin affiliation policy and what makes an affiliate page good
verification.observed: “Not every site that participates in an affiliate program is a thin affiliate. Good affiliate sites add value by offering meaningful content or features. Examples of good affiliate pages include offering additional information about price, original product reviews, rigorous testing and ratings, navigation of products or categories, and product comparisons.”

verification.claim: Google weighs authorship when deciding whether content belongs to a site
verification.observed: “Its stated or implied authorship, meaning, is there an explicit acknowledgement of ownership or responsibility for the content?” listed among four objective factors

verification.claim: Generated content must be fact-checked by a person before publishing, including metadata
verification.observed: “It is critical to manually factcheck and review all AI-generated content for accuracy and trustworthiness before publishing.” and “This review also applies to metadata like <title> elements, meta description elements, structured data, and alternate texts for images”; page states Last updated 2026-10-01 UTC

verification.claim: FTC requires the material connection to be disclosed clearly and conspicuously
verification.observed: “if there’s a connection between an endorser and the marketer that a significant minority of consumers wouldn’t expect and it would affect how they evaluate the endorsement, that connection should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously.”

verification.claim: Organic search traffic is allowed provided it lands on this site first
verification.observed: §6(f): “so long as you comply with the Agreement and those paid or unpaid search results send users to your site and not directly, or indirectly via a Redirecting Link, to an Amazon Site.”

verification.claim: Qualified affiliate links are not link spam
verification.observed: “It's not a violation of our policies to have such links as long as they are qualified with a rel="nofollow" or rel="sponsored" attribute value to the <a> tag.”
